# Which of your route accounts are not worth the drive?

> Free tool for lawn, pool, pest, cleaning and other recurring route businesses. Paste your accounts (price, visits, minutes on site, drive minutes) to rank them by profit per route hour including driving, and see which to keep, reprice or drop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
